enrp1: Here's how a new member joins your group plan now. No paper forms, and nothing typed twice. It all starts with one link.
It starts on your service page. Under your billing, choose enrol a new member, then send them their own link.
Type their name, their e-mail, the plans they're joining, and the date their cover starts. Then press send.
They get their own link by e-mail. Only they can open it, and it stays open for sixty days.
On their phone, their name, their company and their cover are already filled in. It takes about ten minutes.
They add their details and their family, and for group life, who it pays. The health questions take a single tick for most people, and they sign on the screen with a finger.
When they're done, they're told so. If they haven't finished, they get a reminder every working day, and after five reminders, we let you know.
Then you get an e-mail saying it's ready for you to check. You see Guardian's own form, already filled in, and you never see their health answers.
You complete the employer's part, tick that you're authorised, and approve it. That's your last step.
It goes straight to Guardian Life's group benefits team, on their own application form, with the health declaration and the signature attached. Our branch is copied.
Our team gets a task the same moment, and we follow Guardian up every three working days until the cover is in place.
On your page, you see where every new member stands. Waiting on them, ready for you to check, or sent to Guardian Life.
One link, nothing retyped, and every step on the record. That's our branch. A journey, not a transaction.
